title: Cohesion from who actually goes
overseerSummary: Bonus comes from the pair history of the people sent, so adding a stranger lowers it gradually instead of zeroing it, and the picker shows it change as you pick.

proposals.title: Cohesion computed from the party that goes, using the bond ledger
proposals.problem: The team bonus (up to +18% damage and +9% armour) belongs to a saved Team record and not to the people on the sortie. Sortie.launch grants it when every member going is on the active team (sortie.js:224-225), then scores the whole team including members who stayed home. With a five-member team at 12 runs and pair records at 12: the bonus is 10.9% for all five, 10.9% for one member alone, 10.9% for three, and 0 for the same five plus one outsider. The sortie save omits run.teamId and run.bonus (sortie.js:294-303), and resume() rebuilds the run from that record (sortie.js:312-335), so a run resumed after a reload fights without the bonus and settle() skips Crew.completed (sortie.js:511). Team.runs duplicates the per-pair run counter the Bonds ledger keeps (bonds.js:115), and the team's remove/replace/death bookkeeping (crew.js:133-190) re-implements what pair records do on their own, since a pair that is gone has no runs. Teamwork is displayed from CHA alone (stats.js:65, printed at game.js:1301) while the bonus uses (CHA x 0.7 + WIS x 0.3) x social x class (crew.js:72-76).
evidence: sortie.js:224-225 `asTeam = team && charIds.every(cid => team.members.includes(cid)) ? team : null; co = asTeam ? Crew.cohesion(gs, asTeam) : null`; crew.js:88-102 cohesion() takes the team and uses team.runs and membersOf(team).

sortie.js:126-131 fighterFor reads run.bonus; sortie.js:257-258 sets run.teamId and run.bonus; persist() at sortie.js:294-303 writes id, party, loot, zone, started and state only; resume() at sortie.js:312-335 does `run = { ...saved, gs, mission, field }`.

Scratch coh.js on the real Crew and Bonds modules (five-member team, team.runs 12, every pair at 12 runs): shipped bonus all five 10.9%, one member 10.9%, three members 10.9%, five + stranger 0.0%, four + stranger 0.0%. Pair-based (the formula below): all five 10.9%, one member 0.0%, three members 10.5%, five + stranger 9.1% (mean pair runs 8.0), four + stranger 8.5%.

missions.js has no team or cohesion reference (grep), so Gate fights get no bonus. bonds.js:115 `if (event === 'mission') p.runs++` already counts missions walked together per pair, for survivors only (sortie.js:459 passes `came`); bonds.js:193-215 accord() already scores a party from its pair values.
crew.js:142 and 168 scale team.runs by kept/before after a change or a death; pair records produce the same effect directly (bonds.js:228-246 mourn deletes the fallen's pairs).
stats.js:65 `teamwork: { stat: 'cha', fmt: 'pct', f: s => s.cha * 0.02 }` has no reader but the sheet's generic loop (game.js:1297-1303); crew.js:72-76 is the formula in use.
proposals.change: 1) crew.js: cohesion(state, party) takes characters; a team object is accepted and mapped through membersOf for the Teams box. rapport = 1 - exp(-meanPairRuns / RAPPORT_RUNS), meanPairRuns = mean of Bonds.peek(a, b).runs (0 when no record) over the party's pairs; skill and accord are unchanged. Returns { bonus, rapport, skill, accord, runs: meanPairRuns, strength }. 2) sortie.js: launch no longer needs the party to match a team. fighterFor computes the multipliers from Crew.cohesion(gs, party characters), cached on the run for its life and recomputed when resume() rebuilds the run, so no bonus is persisted. TEAM_LINE reads co.runs. Teams stay as saved lists (picker presets, lodging rule, outfit.js quartermaster) and lose runs, completed(), the kept/before scaling and the rapport text in the Teams box. 3) bonds.js: note() and together() take an optional runs weight (default 1) for the 'mission' event; settle passes 1 for a win and 0.5 for a loss, which keeps the half credit Team.runs gave a defeat. 4) No migration: pair records already count every mission walked together, and min(team.runs, pair.runs) is pair.runs wherever the ledger is complete. A team older than the ledger keeps the rapport the ledger supports and no more. 5) Gate runs are unchanged. 6) sortie.js launch builds the fighters before it sets c.mission (now sortie.js:263 then 265) and returns the thrown message instead of leaving the party flagged out with Quests.begin's cost spent. 7) stats.js DERIVED.teamwork becomes CHA x 0.7 + WIS x 0.3 (fmt 'dec'); Crew.teamwork multiplies the social and class factors on top, so the sheet shows the base figure the bonus starts from. 8) The picker shows the live cohesion of the current picks with its three terms, through partyFacts.
proposals.playerEffect: Any group that has walked out together gets a bonus proportional to its history, and the picker shows it change as members are added or removed. Adding a healer who has not walked with the team lowers the mean gradually (10.9% to 9.1% with one stranger among six) and does not zero it. Sending one member of a team alone no longer carries the whole team's bonus. A run resumed after a reload keeps its bonus and credits its pairs.
proposals.secondOrder: Bond events other than 'mission' (shift 0.06, lodging 0.15) still move pair value and accord but not runs, so only walking out together builds rapport, as designed. Grief, tactics trust and cohesion now read one ledger. systems-one-debrief adds 'mission' events for Gate runs, so Gate work builds Field rapport. Fewer places mutate Team state, which removes the case where the Team record disagrees with the roster. Lodging 'one team only' rules and Outfit.teamMembers are unaffected. loop-readout calls Crew.cohesion(gs, party); the signature above is the one to build against.
proposals.risks: The Teams box text ('carried by the people who stay', sortie.js:806) and TEAM_LINE must be rewritten. A team whose rapport came mostly from before the ledger existed, or from runs where only some members went, loses the part the ledger does not support. Lost runs count 0.5 as before. The sheet's Teamwork field changes from a percent of CHA to a decimal on every character. sortie.js is also edited by the other proposals in this lens; the picker line goes through partyFacts. Gate balance is not touched because Gate runs get no cohesion.
proposals.response: Design attack: the seed rule is min(team.runs, pair.runs), which equals the pair record wherever the ledger is complete, so no migration step is needed and none is added; the 0.5 credit for a lost run is kept through the optional runs weight on the 'mission' event; Gate cohesion is dropped from scope instead of capped, so there is no unmeasured Gate balance change; the picker line is one of the partyFacts entries with a single owner. 'Still a bigger number': the change is to which people the number is attached to and to what feeds it, not its size (maximum unchanged at 18%). Engineering attack: the new signature Crew.cohesion(state, characters) is stated above for loop-readout; it accepts a team object as well so existing callers keep working; cohesion is recomputed on resume, which fixes the dropped bonus and the skipped Crew.completed the antagonist found in persist(); a Node check for it belongs to the headless harness (launch, persist, drop the run, resume, compare the fighter's damage). Deleting Team.runs removes the rapport text that loop-readout reads; it should read co.runs instead.

verdicts.attack: It demotes Teams to presets and rewrites their UI text; Gate runs gain up to +18% power with no retune; seeding pair runs from team.runs encodes the bug being fixed; and the result is still a multiplier on damage and armour, a bigger number, now attached to the people who went. Three proposals edit the picker it adds a line to.
verdicts.evidenceCheck: Verified: sortie.js:223-225 every() passes for any subset of the team and crew.js:88-104 scores the saved team; my Node run: a team of five with 12 runs gives bonus 0.110 and a team of one with 12 runs gives 0.113, so one member launched alone carries the whole team's bonus; team plus a stranger gets 0; bonds.js:115 p.runs++ per 'mission'; missions.js has no cohesion reference (grep); stats.js:65 teamwork = CHA x 0.02 is read by nothing while crew.js:72-76 computes (CHA x 0.7 + WIS x 0.3).
verdicts.demand: Seed with min(team.runs, pair runs). Keep the 0.5 for a lost run by passing a multiplier on the 'mission' event (sortie.js:459 passes none today). Cap the Gate bonus or show a Gate harness number. The picker's live cohesion line is one of the three picker edits that must have one owner.

verdicts.attack: It deletes Team.runs and the rapport text (crew.js:133-190, sortie.js:793-797, 805, 816) that loop-readout reads through Crew.cohesion(gs, team); Gate runs gaining up to +18% is a balance change; pair runs count a loss as 1 where Team.runs counted 0.5.
verdicts.evidenceCheck: Verified sortie.js:224-225 and crew.js:88-102: a launch of one team member gets the whole team's bonus (my Node: team of five with runs 12 gives 0.114, a team of that one member 0.110) and five plus an outsider get 0; missions.js has no cohesion reference; bonds.js:115 p.runs++ on 'mission'; crew.js:142 and 168 kept/before scaling; stats.js:65 teamwork has no reader by grep while crew.js:72 is the one used. Also found: persist() (sortie.js:299-302) omits run.teamId and run.bonus, so a run resumed after a reload rebuilds fighters with no cohesion bonus and settle() skips Crew.completed; computing cohesion from the party at fighterFor time fixes this and the spec should say so.
verdicts.demand: 1) Seed pair runs with min(team.runs, pair.runs) and keep the 0.5 for lost runs in the 'mission' event. 2) A smaller MAX_BONUS for Gate runs or a harness check. 3) Publish the new Crew.cohesion(state, chars) signature before loop-readout is built. 4) Recompute cohesion on resume and add a Node test for it.
